title: The Alchemist arrives
motion_prompt: Over three seconds, the Alchemist bends the lantern-holding elbow and gently lifts the same upright lit lantern from hip to chest height. Keep the flame intensity and global scene brightness constant, without a flash, growing glow, particle effect or revealing light. Keep the face neutral and body, feet, other arm, costume and closed gate stationary. Hold the final pose without a nod or reaction. Use a fixed camera, unchanged pixel-art rendering and palette, stable scenery and lighting. No camera motion, text, dialogue, captions, symbols, particles or audio. This is a one-off neutral arrival introduction, not a response to player ideas or results.

allow: Once when the ch1-n2-dark-vault arrival panel first appears, before the child responds or the encounter begins.
stop: Stop at the final pose after the one-off introduction.
Stop immediately when the child leaves the arrival panel, navigates away, pauses, or the page becomes hidden.
With reduced motion enabled, show the first still frame and skip playback.
forbid: Never trigger from tentative ideas, conjectures, draft typing, chip choices, hint requests, tutor generation, correctness checks or answer results.
Never play as a response to a gate opening or staying shut, a Seal, completion or reward.
Never replay automatically, loop, delay input, change the closed gate, emit audio or display a timer.
